title: KU Architecture & Design Alumni Awards recognize 11 distinguished alumni
summary_en: The KU School of Architecture & Design has named recipients of its 2025 Architecture & Design Alumni Awards, recognizing graduates whose careers have advanced design, innovation and community impact.
title_cn: KU Architecture & Design Alumni Awards recognize 11 distinguished alumni

title: 12 instructional faculty members promoted in past year
summary_en: Twelve individuals at the University of Kansas Lawrence and Edwards campuses have earned instructional faculty promotions over the past year. “These educators represent some of the best in teaching and research excellence,” said Arash Mafi, chief academic officer, provost and executive vice chancellor.
title_cn: 12 instructional faculty members promoted in past year
